## Hinge question · Three components {#iv2-hinge .component-lesson .vector-lesson}

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">Given <span data-math="\mathbf a=(2,-1,3)"></span> and <span data-math="\mathbf b=(-1,4,2)"></span>, find <span data-math="2\mathbf a-\mathbf b"></span>.</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="(3,2,8)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="(5,2,4)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="(5,-6,4)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="(3,-5,1)"></span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="2(2,-1,3)-(-1,4,2)=(4+1,-2-4,6-2)=(5,-6,4)"></span></div>
</div>

::: notes
Additional diagnostic immediately before Example 3.7. Correct 3. Distractor 1 computes 2a+b. Distractor 2 subtracts in x and z but adds the y-components, giving −2+4=2 rather than −2−4=−6. Distractor 4 computes a−b and omits the scalar 2. Default 60 seconds, adjustable. Students keep a fist on their chest until the teacher says “show”, then display 1–4 fingers simultaneously. Timer expiry does not reveal. Ready: proceed to Example 3.7. Divided: compare one component at a time with a partner and revote. Needs explanation: write 2a=(4,−2,6), bracket every component of b, and have students explain the middle component before trying again.
:::
